thread:
mira: Quick design question  uploaded a compact approval mock (Figma). Main tradeoffs: inline reason collection (collapsed preview) vs modal prompted reason, and how bulk undo/toast should behave. Thoughts?
sam: Love collapsed preview for density. Worried about discoverability though. Maybe show a 1-line teaser: 'No reason' -> focus opens small textarea.
olivia: Agree on teaser. Copy idea: teaser text = 'Add reason (optional)' when empty, and 'Reason saved' when present. For forced reasons use 'Reason required' with red outline.
kevin: Implementation: collapsed preview should be a button with aria-expanded, not just a div. `button[aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="reason-123"]` then panel gets role="region". That prevents keyboard traps.
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: toggles must announce state; textarea should have aria-describedby linking to character limits. If reason is required, announce on focus that it's required.
mira: For bulk approve shortcut (A), we scoped it to list focus. On bulk approve, UX wants an undo toast for 7s. If reasons are required, bulk approve should show a modal summarizing which rows lack reasons and block until filled.
sam: Good. Also microcopy: toast text = 'Approved 12 items. Undo' with Undo as a button. For large counts (>50) show 'Approvals are being processed; you'll get a notification when done.'
olivia: For required reasons modal, offer quick templates (chips) and an inline 'apply to all' checkbox. That speeds reviewer work. But beware of accidental mass-applying. Show confirmation when 'apply to all' is used.
kevin: Keyboard: when modal opens, trap focus, first tabbable = template chips, then textarea, then actions. Pressing Enter on a chip inserts it into textarea. We'll add unit tests for focus order and keyboard insertion.
qa-bot: Test tasks added: 'reason-preview-keyboard', 'bulk-approve-toast-announce', 'required-reason-blocking-modal'. Scheduling on next CI.
a11y-bot: For toast SR behavior: use role="status" and aria-live="polite" for small batches. For bulk ops that run async, announce 'Approval started for X items' then update to 'Completed' once done. Avoid assertive unless blocking.
mira: Visual nit: collapsed reason preview needs a subtle affordance (chevron or pencil icon). Also ensure contrast for required state meets 4.5:1.
sam: Tiny UX ask: make reason teaser focusable in tab order before the approve CTA so keyboard users can add reason before approving.
olivia: I'll draft three microcopy options for teaser and modal header and post in an hour for a quick poll.
mira: Action items: 1) collapsed reason preview as accessible button w/ region 2) required-reason modal summarizing missing reasons with templates + apply-to-all (confirm) 3) bulk approve hotkey scoped + toast behavior per a11y-bot 4) QA tasks queued 5) copy variants from Olivia.
kevin: Starting a small PR to wire aria attrs and unit tests. ETA: tomorrow morning.
mira: Thanks everyone  will update Figma and tag the PR/QA when ready. :seedling:
